spec.description: Tier 2: one application (service.namespace) - services, RED per endpoint, failures, logs.

spec.expr: sum by (service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

sum by (service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) / sum by (service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

sum by (service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"4.."}[$__range])) / sum by (service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

sum by (service_name, http_route) (route_class:http_requests:rate5m{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route=~"$route", status_class="5xx"})

sum by (service_name, http_route) (route_class:http_requests:rate5m{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route=~"$route", status_class="4xx"})

topk(10, sum by (service_name, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"[45].."}[$__range]))) > 0

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route="$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route="$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_route="$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

(sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", le="0.25"}[5m])) + sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", le="1"}[5m]))) / 2 / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[5m]))

count by (service_name) (count by (service_name, instance) (count_over_time(target_info{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[1h]))) - sum by (service_name) (service:instances:count{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"})
count by (service_name, service_version) (target_info{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", service_version!=""})

spec.title: App status
